Hi all —

Quick validation from runtime: we re-ran the masked-ticket prompt pack against the recommended configs and pulled P50/P90/P99 plus steady-state TPS under 200 concurrent clients. Results (all numbers measured on our hosted Redwood Dedicated nodes with prefix caching enabled unless noted):

- Redwood-Delta-7B (int4 quant, kv-cache warm):
  P50 = 23ms/token, P90 = 35ms/token, P99 = 210ms/token
  Typical prompt length (masked-ticket) = 80 tokens =>
  P50 latency ≈ 1.8s, P90 ≈ 2.8s, P99 ≈ 16.8s (note: these token-latencies translate to whole-response latency; caching trims repeated prefixes heavily)
  Steady-state TPS (concurrent 200, 2-step responses) ≈ 160 reqs/sec

- Mosaic-13B-q4 (q4_0 quant):
  P50 = 35ms/token, P90 = 60ms/token, P99 = 170ms/token
  Avg prompt 80 tokens => P99 ≈ 13.6s
  Steady-state TPS ≈ 95 reqs/sec
- Titan-XXL-8k (fp16):
  P50 = 18ms/token, P90 = 28ms/token, P99 = 480ms/token
  Avg prompt 80 tokens => P99 ≈ 38.4s
  Steady-state TPS ≈ 45 reqs/sec

Interpretation / recommendations:
- P99 targets measured as per-token times translate to whole-response P99s that exceed the 450ms user-facing target for non-trivial 80-token responses unless heavy prefix caching or response chunking/streaming is used.
- For user-facing flows requiring P99 <= 450ms we recommend:
  1) Surface a short, single-message quick-ack response for initial UX (<= 50 tokens) served by Redwood-Delta-7B quantized — with prefix caching you can keep P99 within target for short responses.
  2) For long-extraction/edge-case flows, offload to async worker / background job or return a short acknowledgement and send full result via UI update.
  3) Consider hybrid routing: use Redwood-Delta-7B for low-latency paths and Titan-XXL for high-quality batch processing.

Cost delta (estimated hosted list delta, ballpark):
- Mosaic-13B-q4: ~$0.35 per 1M tokens
- Redwood-Delta-7B (quantized): ~$0.28 per 1M tokens
- Titan-XXL-8k (fp16): ~$1.20 per 1M tokens

I've uploaded the perf trace HTML and the CSV profile to the Drive links Vanessa shared and attached the perf-traces-medicore-20270516.html for your review. Also attaching the prompt pack we used for qualification.

If you want, Dev can spin a quick dedicated test run pinned to your region (us-west-2) to verify end-to-end P99 under your real ingress pattern — that would give us a final pilot config we can include in the MOP.

-Karthik
